title: Meta says its new AI model is ready to compete on coding
slides: Meta just released a coding model. Can it beat GPT-4?
The new model, Code Llama 70B, is open-source.
It outperforms GPT-4 on a specific benchmark, but not all tasks.
Developers can now fine-tune it for their own codebases.
Run a side-by-side test on your next pull request today.
thread_text:
1. The GPT-4 challenger

Code Llama 70B beats GPT-4 on HumanEval, a coding benchmark.

2. Open-source edge

It’s free to download and modify. No API costs.

3. Not a full win

On other tasks like code completion and debugging, GPT-4 still leads.

4. Your codebase, tuned

Developers can fine-tune it on their own repos without sharing data.

5. Run your own test

Take your next pull request and test Code Llama against GPT-4. Which saves more time?
video_script: It beats GPT-4 on some tests.
But GPT-4 wins in other areas.
Test it on your next pull request.
